subject: general
question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

A child born after the death of his father
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e**. 'Posthumous'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **"posthumous"** child is a term used to refer to a child who is born after the death of his or her father.
 
• The term originates from Latin 'posthumus' which means **"born after the father's death".**

Therefore, the** correct answer** is:** 'Posthumous'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's now look at the other words:
 
 
• **'Orphan'**: An orphan is a child whose parents are dead, unknown, or have permanently abandoned them. (अनाथ)
 
• **'Pseudonym':** A pseudonym is a fictitious name, especially one used by an author. (उपनाम)
 
• **'Bigot':** A bigot is a person who is intolerant towards those holding different opinions. (कट्टर)
